success_claim.verified_rule: Both point estimates are within 0.5 percentage points of the claimed endpoints and the paired success-rate delta 95% bootstrap CI is strictly above zero.
success_claim.partially_verified_rule: The paired success-rate delta 95% bootstrap CI is strictly above zero, but one or both claimed numeric endpoints miss the registered tolerance.
success_claim.not_verified_rule: The paired success-rate delta 95% bootstrap CI includes or falls below zero.

margin_claim.verified_rule: The equal-height point estimate is within 0.5 mm of +10 mm and the paired all-valid-pair margin-delta 95% stratified bootstrap CI is strictly above zero.
margin_claim.partially_verified_rule: The paired margin-delta 95% stratified bootstrap CI is strictly above zero, but the +10 mm numeric target misses the registered tolerance.
margin_claim.not_verified_rule: The paired margin-delta 95% stratified bootstrap CI includes or falls below zero, or no complete valid pairs exist.

pitch_claim.verified_rule: The reduction point estimate is within 0.5 percentage points of 31% and the paired pitch-rate delta (PPO minus FSM) 95% stratified bootstrap CI is strictly below zero.
pitch_claim.partially_verified_rule: The paired pitch-rate delta 95% stratified bootstrap CI is strictly below zero, but the 31% numeric target misses the registered tolerance.
pitch_claim.not_verified_rule: The paired pitch-rate delta CI includes or exceeds zero, or the FSM denominator is below the registered near-zero threshold.

missing_continuous_metric_policy: Never impute. Report missing counts and scenario IDs; paired continuous analysis uses complete pairs only and stratifies the bootstrap by height.
seed_policy: Use all selected checkpoints for seeds 11/29/47. For FSM-vs-PPO paired across-seed inference, duplicate the fixed FSM outcome once per training seed and key pairs by seed plus scenario ID; also report every seed separately.
wording_policy: A fallback validation selection, non-supportive confidence interval, or numeric mismatch must be disclosed. The generated resume wording uses actual locked-test values only.
